name: Infection Analyse Results - Part 3
content: We now know for sure that the parasite can be contained by honey, but it looks like honey alone is not enough. Adding some blue fluid seems to be necessary to make the vaccine effective. We are currently testing different combinations of honey and the blue fluid to find the optimal formula for the vaccine. We are hopeful that we will soon have a viable vaccine that can be used to treat infected individuals and prevent the spread of the infection.
